- CVE-2025-29088: Fixed integer overflow through the SQLITE_DBCONFIG_LOOKASIDE component (bsc#1241078)

Other fixes:

- Updated to version 3.49.1 from Factory (jsc#SLE-16032)

notes.text: An integer overflow can be triggered in SQLite's `concat_ws()` function. The resulting, truncated integer is then used to allocate a buffer. When SQLite then writes the resulting string to the buffer, it uses the original, untruncated size and thus a wild Heap Buffer overflow of size ~4GB can be triggered. This can result in arbitrary code execution.
